scripts.migrate:create: cd apps/server && bun --bun x node-pg-migrate create --migrations-dir src/db/migrations --migration-file-language ts
scripts.migrate:up: cd apps/server && bun --bun x node-pg-migrate up --migrations-dir src/db/migrations
scripts.migrate:down: cd apps/server && bun --bun x node-pg-migrate down --migrations-dir src/db/migrations
